description: The assistant feature aspect. Node runtime: define the AiProvider slot and register an OpenAI provider using OPENAI_API_KEY with structured JSON outputs matching the schema { summary, category, importance (1-10), needs_reply, suggested_reply }, plus a deterministic mock provider used when no key is configured so the app always works. Implement analyzeEmail and analyzeInbox (calling the mail aspect's applyAnalysis), getDailySummary (aggregating the user's unread emails into greeting, highlights and suggested first actions, cached per day in MongoDB), generateReply (using the stored writing style, checking the billing quota first) and getWritingStyle/updateWritingStyle. Expose all of it over GraphQL and analyze newly synced emails on start. Browser runtime: register the daily summary dashboard panel with top weight, register the Generate Reply action into the mail EmailAction slot, and register the /assistant/settings route plus a user-menu item. Runtime files only.

The billing feature aspect. Node runtime: MongoDB-backed user plan store defaulting new users to Free with a 30 AI reply monthly quota that resets on the period boundary. Implement getPlan, listPlans, canUse (mapping each gated feature to the plans that allow it), consumeAiReply (throwing a clear quota-exceeded error the UI can surface as an upgrade prompt) and changePlan, exposed over GraphQL. Seed the demo user on the Free plan with some replies already used so the quota meter is meaningful. Browser runtime: register the /pricing (public) and /billing (protected) routes, a 'Billing' user-menu item, and the plan dashboard panel. Runtime files only.

The cleanup feature aspect. Node runtime: define the CleanupRule slot and register the built-in rules through it — newsletters/marketing from the last 30 days (archive, free), promotional emails older than 30 days (delete, pro), unread marketing older than 7 days (archive, pro), and low-importance repeat senders (archive, pro). Implement listSuggestions, previewSuggestion and executeSuggestion by reading and mutating emails through the mail aspect, never touching its store directly. Report minutes saved to the productivity aspect when a cleanup executes. Expose over GraphQL. Browser runtime: register the /cleanup route (protected), the 'Cleanup' navigation item with a suggestion-count badge, and the cleanup dashboard panel. Runtime files only.

The mail feature aspect. Node runtime: define the MailProvider slot and register two built-in providers — a Gmail provider that uses the Google tokens from the platform aspect to fetch messages, archive, trash and send via the Gmail API, and a Mock provider used for the demo account and when Gmail is unavailable, seeded from the email entity mocks. Expose the GraphQL schema and resolvers for listEmails, getEmail, getTriageCounts, syncEmails, archiveEmails, deleteEmails, sendReply and applyAnalysis, backed by a MongoDB typegoose model. Seed demo emails on start. Browser runtime: define the EmailAction slot with registerEmailAction, register the /inbox route (protected) and the 'Inbox' navigation item with an urgent-count badge, and register the inbox summary dashboard panel. Runtime files only.

The productivity feature aspect. Node runtime: MongoDB-backed digest store, implement trackAction (upserting today's digest and accumulating minutes saved by action kind), getTodayDigest, listDigests, and notification preference read/update, all exposed over GraphQL. Seed a week of demo digest history on start so the trend is populated. Browser runtime: register the /digest route (protected), the 'Digest' navigation item, the time-saved indicator as a header action, and the digest dashboard panel. Runtime files only.
